name: weather
description: Weather and geocoding via the keyless Open-Meteo API — current conditions, multi-day forecasts, and place-name lookup. Accepts a place name or explicit latitude/longitude. No API key or credentials required.
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: weather.current
tools.description: Get current weather conditions for a place name or explicit coordinates (temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind, and a text description).

location.description: Place name to geocode, e.g. 'Paris' or 'Tokyo, Japan'. Provide this OR latitude+longitude.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Use with longitude instead of location.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Use with latitude instead of location.

tools.name: weather.forecast
tools.description: Get a daily weather forecast for a place name or explicit coordinates (per-day high/low temperature, precipitation, and a text description).

location.description: Place name to geocode. Provide this OR latitude+longitude.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Use with longitude instead of location.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Use with latitude instead of location.

tools.name: weather.geocode
tools.description: Search for places by name and return matching coordinates.

name.description: Place name to search for, e.g. 'Springfield'
